# @techspokes/typescript-wsdl-client

> Generate type-safe TypeScript SOAP clients, OpenAPI 3.1 specs, and
> production-ready Fastify REST gateways from WSDL/XSD definitions.

## Quick Facts

- CLI binary: wsdl-tsc
- Node.js >= 24.0.0
- Runtime dependency: soap
- Output: TypeScript client + OpenAPI 3.1 + Fastify gateway
- All output is deterministic and diff-friendly

## Install

npm install --save-dev @techspokes/typescript-wsdl-client
npm install soap

## Primary Command

npx wsdl-tsc pipeline \
  --wsdl-source <path-or-url> \
  --client-dir <output-dir> \
  --openapi-file <output-path> \
  --gateway-dir <output-dir> \
  --gateway-service-name <slug> \
  --gateway-version-prefix <version>

## Profile selection

Before upgrading a 1.1.x consumer, read [migration](docs/migration.md#from-11x-to-120). Legacy remains the default, but regeneration can change colliding DTO names, mapped stream records and corrected scalar/simple-content values. Preserve matched artifacts, lockfiles and app/test customizations; adopt a new profile separately. npm published 1.1.5 and 1.1.8, while 1.1.6/1.1.7 were unpublished candidates.

Use legacy pipeline for one source, or pipeline --services-config services.json for independent legacy sources. The aggregate typed createClients binds each runtime WSDL, endpoint and security separately; no checked/app/test aggregate mode is available. See [composition](docs/gateway-guide.md#multi-service-setup).

Use pipeline --model checked-components-v1 for the bounded document/literal or SOAP 1.1 RPC/encoded string profile. Checked replies remain buffered checked values. Legacy buffered success uses envelopes; opt-in legacy NDJSON/JSON-array streams deliver generated DTO records directly through node-soap requestStream. See [migration](docs/migration.md#from-11x-to-120).

## Output inventory

- client/client.ts: typed SOAP client class
- client/types.ts: TypeScript interfaces from XSD
- client/utils.ts: runtime metadata
- client/catalog.json: compiled WSDL representation
- openapi.json: OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- gateway/plugin.ts: Fastify plugin entry point
- gateway/routes.ts: route aggregator module
- gateway/routes/: route handlers with typed request bodies
- gateway/runtime.ts: envelope builders and error handler
- gateway/schemas.ts: schema registration module
- gateway/schemas/: JSON schemas for validation and serialization
- gateway/_typecheck.ts: build-time type-check fixture
